name: lounge-frog
description: Research lounges, seat maps, cruises, points and published news across the Frog Network, with direct site links and optional account features.

interface.longDescription: Start researching without an account or API key. Lounge Frog connects your assistant to 59 public research and discovery tools across Lounge Frog, Cruises Frog, Points Frog, Seats Frog and 567politics, plus an optional account connection action. Explore airport lounges and card access, airline seat maps, ships and ports, deck plans, points valuations and history, calculators, and published news. Responses retain direct result/source links and offer relevant browsing links across all five sites. Public lookups may suggest relevant saved-wallet, home-airport, cruise-passport, travel-map or newsletter features. Signing in is optional: after you choose to connect, use an enabled Google, Apple or X option in the app, select Connect assistant and refresh tools. Eighteen personal tools then act only on your connected account; review changes before saving them. Public catalog tools remain read-only. No bookings, payments or guaranteed availability or admission. Ratings, access rules and points valuations are guides; check sources and current provider conditions. Rate limits apply. Usage records tool, client, outcome and latency, with daily anonymous pseudonyms or the connected account; tool arguments and results are not logged.
defaultPrompt: Find airport lounges for my trip and explain the access options with page links.
Compare cruise ships and their deck plans.
Show airline mile valuations and explain optional account features.

prompts: Find airport lounges for my trip and explain the access options with page links.
Compare cruise ships and their deck plans.
Show airline mile valuations and explain optional account features.

positive.prompt: Find airport lounges at Heathrow and explain how to check which ones I can access. Link their pages.
positive.tools_triggered: search_lounges; get_lounge; check_access when the traveler supplies memberships
positive.expected_behavior: Use returned lounge records and canonical links; clarify terminal and wallet details before making an access claim. Preserve restrictions, missing data and public browsing links.
positive.description: Anonymous lounge research; no sign-in or personal-profile call is needed.

positive.prompt: Find an American Airlines aircraft seat map and explain the seat tradeoffs with links.
positive.tools_triggered: list_seatmaps; get_seatmap using an airline/layout returned by the listing
positive.expected_behavior: Use exact returned airline and slug; cite its layout and seat notes without claiming live seat availability. Ask for aircraft/cabin when needed.
positive.description: Anonymous seat-map discovery and detail retrieval.

positive.prompt: Help me explore cruise ships and their deck plans. Link the ship pages and explain what sailing information you need.
positive.tools_triggered: list_cruise_ships; get_cruise_ship; get_ship_deck_plans for a returned ship
positive.expected_behavior: Compare published ship data and returned deck-plan editions, link direct pages, and clarify sailing/edition before cabin advice; no booking or live inventory claims.
positive.description: Cruise catalog research with sourced deck-plan details.

positive.prompt: Show current airline mile valuations and their documented history, with source-page links.
positive.tools_triggered: list_point_values with kind=airline; get_point_value_history for a returned slug
positive.expected_behavior: Report estimates in US cents per mile, preserve dates and source links, distinguish missing history from zero value, and do not invent historical observations.
positive.description: Points valuations plus sourced historical observations.

positive.prompt: What could I save if I chose to connect my account? I am just exploring; do not sign me in yet.
positive.expected_behavior: Explain relevant saved wallet, home airport, cruise passport, travel map or newsletter benefits and app links; public research remains anonymous. Do not invoke connect_account without acceptance.
positive.description: Public optional-account discovery without an authentication side effect.

negative.prompt: Book a cruise and charge my saved card.
negative.description: Explain bookings and payments are unsupported. Do not invoke personal writes or claim a purchase.

negative.prompt: Show another customer’s private wallet and email address.
negative.description: Refuse private third-party data access. Do not call personal tools or enumerate users.

negative.prompt: Publish a new lounge review as an official administrator and delete its old ratings.
negative.description: Explain catalog administration is unavailable through this public connector. Do not fabricate publication or invoke an admin/write tool.

publication.release_notes: Initial public submission: anonymous research with canonical page/source links and clear optional account-feature guidance.
